name: SHiNESS
full_name: Search for Hidden Neutrinos at the European Spallation Source
summary: SHiNESS is proposed at the European Spallation Source, Lund. This hidden-neutrino proposal has explicit dark-sector extensions; not every sterile-neutrino mass and mixing range can account for cosmic dark matter.
detection_principle: A liquid-scintillator detector near the ESS target would study anomalous scattering, oscillations and multilepton decays. Subsequent studies assess visible long-lived signals from broader dark sectors, including ALPs.

results.summary: The original proposal primarily gives hidden-neutrino sensitivity; later papers analyze long-lived neutralinos and ALPs, all as projections.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
